title: Shaam walo na satao
body:
Shaam waalo
Shaam Waalo x 6
<<MINI>>
Shaam Waalo Na Sataao x 2
<<DIVIDER>>
Kehta Tha Muhaari, Ghurbat Pe Hamaari, Bass Kar Na Rulaao, Shaam Waalo Na Sataao x 3
1. Sar Chacha Ka Mere Iss Waaste Girjaata Hai, Inko Behno Ka Khulaa Sar Jo Nazar Aata Hai, Ghayoor Ke Sar Ko, Lillaah Na Logo, Neze Pe Uthaao
<<MINI>>
Shaam Waalo Na Sataao x 3
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Haaye Kya Kya Na Sitam Dhaaye Hai Ham Par Tumne, Hadd Yeh Hai Chhinli Tatheer Ki Chaadar Tumne, Ab Tum Wahi Chadar, Neze Pe Uthaakar, Hamko Na Dikhaao
<<MINI>>
Shaam Waalo Na Sataao x 3
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Ham Ulil-Amr Hai Shaayad Yeh Nahi Tumko Khabar, Ham Agar Chaahe Toh Barse Abhi Tum Par Patthar, Majboor Samajhkar, Haaye Tum Aale Nabi Par, Pathhar Na Giraao
<<MINI>>
Shaam Waalo Na Sataao x 3
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Kaise Neze Pe Uthaaya Gaya Sar Asgher Ka, Kaise Paamaal Kiya Ibne-Hassan Ka Laasha, Yeh Zulm Ke Kisse, Mat Saamne Jaake, Maao Ko Sunaao
<<MINI>>
Shaam Waalo Na Sataao x 3
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Shaam-e-Aashur Se Yeh Soyi Nahi Hai Ab Tak, Mai Toh Roya Hun Yeh Royi Bhi Nahi Hai Ab Tak, Tum Maarlo Mujhko, Haaye Par Meri Phuphi Ko, Durre Na Lagaao
<<MINI>>
Shaam Waalo Na Sataao x 3
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Raaste Bhar Yeh Tarapte Rahe Paani Ke Liye, Tumko Maalum Nahi Kabse Hai Pyaase Bache, Bacho Ko Dikhaakar, Iss Tarha Zamin Par, Paani Na Bahaao, Shaam Waalo Na Sataao x 3
7. Aaj Batki Hai Wahaan Naam Pe Zainab Ke Ridaa, Kal Taqallum Wahaa Bimaar Mera Kehta Rahaa, Yeh Aale Nabi Hai, Haaye Tum Aise Na Inko, Beparda Phiraao
<<MINI>>
Shaam Waalo Na Sataao x 3
